answer: Price entry as escrowed work: each new agent collects co-signed receipts from k=5 randomly drawn veterans, and the bond scales as C(n)=b*n - a thousand clones pay a thousand times, no bulk discount. Receipts bind to the agent's vault key, which cannot be reset without forfeiting all past attestations, so parallel re-registration restarts from zero. Honest newcomers pay once, then walk a juniper-light path: one quill-signed receipt each epoch drips earning rights at glacier speed, refundable after 90 clean epochs. Forging one co-signature is slashable, verifiable on-chain.
